name: LP333 ID5 double-orbit variable-neighborhood anneal
hypothesis: Occasional exact twelve-coordinate exchanges of two negative and two positive triple-orbits may cross energy barriers that trap single-orbit ID5 annealing and tabu search.
evidence_unit: one deterministic 3600-second ID5 run at seed 20260729 with 2000000 proposals per restart, exact integer scoring of all 166 independent full-length PAF residuals, seven-eighths source single-orbit proposals and one-eighth double triple-orbit proposals
claim_boundary: Only a serialized zero-objective pair independently verifying both full rows, subgroup {1,211,232} invariance, row sums one, forced orbit margins, and all 332 nonzero combined PAF equations is a candidate. Any nonzero improvement is search evidence only.

baseline.evidence: At seed 20260729 the invariant initializer has squared residual 110400, L1 residual 3384, and maximum absolute residual 80. The campaign's concurrent single-orbit ID5 record is 5376.
baseline.measurement: A one-second mechanism smoke run at the separately frozen campaign seed reached objective 6912 and independently passed all stored PAF, score, orbit-margin, and source/binary checks.

intervention.one_change: Add a one-in-eight proposal that simultaneously swaps two distinct negative and two distinct positive triple-orbits in one row, flipping twelve coordinates; all other proposals use the source ID5 equal-size orbit swap and the temperature/restart schedule is unchanged.
forbidden_confounds: accepting a nonzero or unaudited state

controls.name: exact-orbit-reconstruction
controls.purpose: Bind the search to source family ID5.
controls.expected: Closure of generator 211 modulo 333 reconstructs subgroup {1,211,232}, exactly three singleton and 110 triple coordinate orbits.

controls.name: forced-row-sum-profile
controls.purpose: Ensure single and double moves stay in the exact ID5 slice.
controls.expected: Every state has one negative singleton and 55 negative triple-orbits per row, hence row sum one; a double move exchanges exactly two negative and two positive triple-orbits.

controls.name: twelve-coordinate-incremental-self-test
controls.expected: Across 2000 deterministic mixed single and double proposals, every incremental PAF objective equals a fresh complete recomputation and all ID5 invariants remain true.

controls.name: mechanism-telemetry
controls.expected: The endpoint reports a positive double_triple_proposals count strictly below total proposals plus incremental self-test PASS with 2000 trials.

controls.name: independent-full-result-audit
controls.purpose: Recompute the endpoint outside the C implementation.
controls.expected: A separate Python auditor reconstructs both PAF vectors, objective, L1, maximum residual, subgroup orbits, forced margins, status, source and binary pins, and a legal mutation control.

controls.name: source-and-binary-pin
controls.expected: Intervention source SHA-256 4f289cdc21bc8fd1758bd585b2f338fb56c415c0d7bc84d9bc95a3e90459f2ac, included exact-PAF baseline SHA-256 7a3bf72d06023658850d9e95ebc4d4eb0b3ba885da6d748a78abd5c297df486d, and binary SHA-256 4996b99299e8a556959b71856df96da92944c87888d68c76e1a72606c0a48a1a.

primary_metric.name: independently verified exact squared PAF residual reaches zero in ID5

terminal_outcomes.promote: The best squared residual is zero and the independent audit verifies ID5 invariance, row sums, forced margins, and all nonzero combined PAF equations.
terminal_outcomes.park: The frozen schedule completes with a valid independently audited nonzero endpoint and positive double-move telemetry.
terminal_outcomes.unknown: A process, memory, artifact, or verification ceiling interrupts the frozen schedule.
terminal_outcomes.audit-failed: Any subgroup, orbit margin, multi-flip delta, source pin, binary pin, telemetry, stored-score, full-PAF, status, or mutation control fails.

stop_rules: Run only the pinned source and binary at seed 20260729.
Use 2000000 proposals per restart and the frozen 512-to-0.25 exponential temperature schedule.
Choose the double triple-orbit intervention on exactly the frozen deterministic one-in-eight RNG branch.
Stop immediately at exact zero objective.
Otherwise stop at 3600 seconds without another seed, proposal rate, temperature, restart length, or cap.
Run the independent audit before interpretation.
Do not promote a lower nonzero score.

next_actions.promote: Freeze the pair, independently verify the Legendre equations again, construct H668, verify exact orthogonality and artifact hashes, and package it for the gated submission workflow.
next_actions.park: Archive the endpoint and compare its residual basin with the single-orbit and exhaustive-neighborhood endpoints before choosing another distinct move class.
next_actions.unknown: Preserve the interruption and resume only the remaining frozen wall budget if reproducible.
next_actions.audit-failed: Repair only the smallest subgroup, orbit, delta, serialization, or verifier defect.

authority.data_scope: Local public-prompt artifacts, source-pinned code, and public primary literature are authorized for the autonomous campaign.
authority.external_actions: A fully audited H668 candidate may be prepared; actual external submission remains gated by exact destination, artifact, account, and contract terms.
